rationale: The only substantive ground-truth concern reviewable against this diff is whether Ref2VA (untested) is safe to run by just swapping the model path — Y hits this directly and concretely (finding #4: 4-GPU Ref2VA restart risks OOM given FL2VA-only validation and thin headroom), while X only notes missing Ref2VA examples/pointers without questioning validation status. Y also independently catches a genuine, diff-internal inconsistency (warm-up 'once' vs 'two warmups') and covers more ground (sync-timeout scope, RAM/NUMA analysis, table completeness) with solid code citations, though two of its richer findings (alternate PR-description benchmark rows, 5090.md HBM comparison) reference content outside the shown diff and can't be fully verified, slightly denting precision. X is very rigorous and well-verified but narrower and misses the core reviewer concern entirely.
